name: Vera Bradley, Inc.
summary: Vera Bradley, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, designs and manufactures women's handbags, luggage and travel items, fashion and home accessories, and gifts in the United States. It operates through two segments, Vera Bradley Direct and Vera Bradley Indirect. The company offers bag products, such as backpacks, totes, crossbodies, lunch bags, satchels, clutches, and baby bags; accessories, including ID holders, lanyards, wallets, wristlets, eyewear, various technology accessories, and bag charms.
